senses.gloss: m. (ποκάριον) lock or tuft of wool (used as lint on a wound).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 5">Tosef. Sabb. V (VI), 2; Sabb. 5</cite><cite ref="Shabbat 50a">Sabb. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>בפוק׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בפקו׳</he>; Ms. O. <he>בפיקור׳</he>; corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 77:2">Gen. R. s. 77</cite> <he>נטל</he> … <he>פ׳ וכ׳</he> Jacob … took a tuft of wool and stuck it in his throat; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 132:1">Yalk. ib. 132</cite> <cite ref="Q00325"><he>פוקרי</he></cite> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:3">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>נטל פרקדין וכרכו וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) he took (a rope of) wool and wound it around his neck.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:16:1">Koh. R. to X, 16</cite> <he>אילו הייתי שם פ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>פי׳</he>) had I been there, I should have tied a rope of wool around his (Solomon’s) neck; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 175:4">Yalk. Kings 175</cite> <cite ref="Q01520"><he>פקרין</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 10:1:3">Y. Erub. X, beg. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>כמין פ׳ היו בידו</he> (not <cite ref="Q00822"><he>פיקרין</he></cite>) the T’fillin were in his hand (bundled up) like a tuft of wool (put on a wound).

<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 5:23">Tosef. Kil. V, 23</cite> <he>הפקרית והציפה וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) lint (for wounds) and wool tufts are not subject to the law concerning mixture of wool and flax (<cite ref="K00674"><he>כלאים</he></cite>).
